title: Falsifiability
coreMove: Turn a claim into a test that could clearly prove it wrong.
sourcePressure: The source uses Karl Popper to separate scientific claims from unfalsifiable ones and Wason's work to show the natural pull toward confirmation instead of disproof.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The weak version says being open-minded means gathering more support or arguing both sides.

sourceAnchors.name: Karl Popper
sourceAnchors.detail: the source says Popper treated falsifiability as a criterion separating scientific theories from pseudoscientific ones
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Popper's pressure point is simple: a claim that cannot lose has not earned a win.

sourceAnchors.name: Peter Cathcart Wason
sourceAnchors.detail: the source uses Wason's work to show that people naturally confirm instead of trying to falsify their ideas
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Wason's experiments matter because the mind keeps reaching for the card that says yes when the useful card may say no.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person 'You' direct address, retrospective 'It took her three weeks to see', question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

exampleSpecs.audience: a wellness retailer testing whether a new supplement reduces afternoon fatigue
exampleSpecs.stakes: customers may be sold a story built only from praise cards
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Chris writes the exact result that would make him pull the supplement from the front shelf before reading another glowing testimonial
exampleSpecs.firstImage: sample packets stacked beside a clipboard of praise cards

exampleSpecs.audience: a museum program director who believes evening hours will bring younger visitors
exampleSpecs.stakes: staff overtime could be wasted on an untested assumption
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Margaux commits to a falsifying threshold before the pilot: if under-30 ticket scans do not rise after four Fridays, the hypothesis loses
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a Friday-night ticket scanner blinking under the atrium lights

exampleSpecs.audience: a coach convinced that extra sprint sets improve starts
exampleSpecs.stakes: young swimmers may be exhausted without getting faster off the block
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Henrik times three starts before and after the sprint block and tells the assistant which result would make them stop the new plan
exampleSpecs.firstImage: chlorine haze above lane four as a stopwatch clicks

exampleSpecs.audience: a nonprofit communications lead attached to an urgent subject line
exampleSpecs.stakes: donor fatigue could rise while the team counts only opens
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Kasia says the line must lose if unsubscribes pass a set level, even if open rates climb
exampleSpecs.firstImage: two subject lines printed on sticky notes beside the unsubscribe column

exampleSpecs.audience: a seed cooperative manager defending a new drying process
exampleSpecs.stakes: bad germination could cost growers a short planting window
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Devon compares the failed tray to the pre-written germination cutoff instead of explaining the failure away as weather
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a tray of pale seedlings leaning toward a greenhouse fan

exampleSpecs.audience: a tutoring coordinator claiming a reading game improves comprehension
exampleSpecs.stakes: students may lose six weeks to a tool that only feels engaging
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: You watch Jack set the disproof rule before launch: if cold-read summaries do not improve by week three, the game is entertainment, not instruction
exampleSpecs.firstImage: laminated reading cards spread beside a tablet cart
